sampling.warmup: none: cold first requests are measured deliberately

timing_scope: validated_seconds includes input-policy selection, preprocessing, construction and full checks; whole_process_seconds also includes imports and Python startup. Peak RSS is whole-process high water including imports.
comparison_contract: All configurations finish full checks. Deferred construction alone is not compared as an equally validated result. Alternative prime may choose a different basis of the same checked space.
limitations: One host, bounded cases, no optimality, conditioning or uniform stability claim.
